# Movie controls

@difference Extension: movies can be paused, and the commands for that build on the original movie commands.

The originals play a movie from its first picture to its last: `OpenMovie`, `DrawMovie`, `MoviePlaying` and `CloseMovie`. BlitzLLVM adds commands to control the playback. A movie that is opened still plays by itself the first time it is drawn or asked about, so programs that use only the original commands behave as before.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [PauseMovie](PauseMovie) | Holds the picture, stops the sound and the clock of the movie. |
| [PlayMovie](PlayMovie) | Goes on after a pause. |
| [MovieLength](MovieLength) | How long the movie is, in seconds. |
| [MoviePosition](MoviePosition) | Where the movie is, in seconds. |
